3102d61d8271: <span1>Plays what you have, where you want it.</span1> <span2>Video, audio, streams and web video, trimmed, exported and recorded, on your screen, on a TV or speaker, or across an AVB network, by yourself or with your favourite AI agent.</span2>
823609cc4ff6: Material 3 toolbars float over the picture and slide away as you watch, or stay docked, in light or dark, in your system's accent colour, picture in picture and full screen.
e9f62bfba1c6: The Windows installer and plaa.exe are signed by Scramble Tools LLC, and the macOS package with its Developer ID, notarised by Apple. Each package is installed, upgraded, run, made to play a video and removed in a clean system before a release goes out. See the install notes for what differs between them, and the release for the sources of the libraries the Windows and macOS packages carry.
4c2329716938: Windows releases of plaa are signed by Scramble Tools LLC with <a1>Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing</a1>, and macOS releases with Scramble Tools' Developer ID, notarised by Apple.
840981ec0887: Committers and reviewers: the members of the scrambletoolsllc GitHub organisation, who review every outside contribution before it is merged.
6263ca064f9a: Approvers: the owner of the scrambletoolsllc GitHub organisation, who alone can publish a release, and with it a signing.
18a188fe3b03: Video is decoded on the graphics card where it can be, 8K at 60 frames a second included, and drawn by plaa's own shader: BT.601, BT.709 and BT.2020 colours, 8 to 16 bits, HDR10 and HLG tone mapped for an ordinary screen, and phone videos turned upright. The sound keeps in step with the picture by the output device's own clock.
cc3e703d5fa6: A sound file shows its cover, title, artist and album, with the spectrum of what you hear below them, as bars that rise with it and fall back slowly, or the file's waveform from start to end, the part played in the accent colour, which a click or a drag seeks along.
4ca6fd3d67d0: Or choose Prism from the visualiser menu: a scene in three dimensions that fills the window and moves with the music, a lace orb around a core that swells on each beat, ringed by glass shards rising with the spectrum, over a rippling grid of light.
9dc8ca2429f1: Export (Ctrl+E) saves what plays, as edited, as H.264, HEVC or AV1 with AAC sound, at the file's own size or smaller. plaa encodes on the graphics card where it can (NVENC, AMF, Quick Sync, VAAPI or VideoToolbox) and on the processor otherwise, and the dialogue says which. HDR video keeps its colours in HEVC and AV1.
4b51b9e2a697: Media keys work, and what plays shows with its cover in the system's own controls: MPRIS on Linux, which playerctl drives too, the media flyout on Windows, and Now Playing on macOS. On macOS plaa has its own menu bar, and on macOS and Windows title bars in plaa's colours. On Linux, plaa's packages use the system's FFmpeg and sound server, PipeWire or PulseAudio.
aa4b2a4fabe0: Settings (Ctrl+,) has seven tabs. Appearance chooses light or dark, the system's accent colour or one of plaa's, and how the floating controls look and when they hide. Playback has hardware decoding, the sound output, resuming, folder playlists, the streams' quality, yt-dlp, and Make Default, which makes plaa the system's default app for video and sound files. Storage chooses the folders recordings and saved frames go to; Network, the AVB interface; Language, plaa's language and the languages tracks are chosen by; Agents and Assistant, what the previous sections describe.
77aa7e8d1b39: The Export dialogue over Big Buck Bunny looking up at a butterfly on a tree: H.264, HEVC, AV1 or sound only, encoded on the graphics card, at 1080p as it is, 720p or 480p
3234eaecae83: plaa's Settings over a paused video, on the Appearance tab: Follow system, Light and Dark, the system accent colour switch and the colour swatches, and the floating controls' settings
1635d69a704b: Material Design 3, light or dark, and the accent colour from the system or one chosen
